scope: All six tool errors and observed business-verification failures in three valid local historical replays. Prior cloud T01 is summarized separately. Environment-invalid attempts are excluded.
method: High-level attribution from visible input, tool calls, feedback, state registration and source code; not a verbatim reconstruction of model deliberation.

chunk_alias.C: E10 canonical chunk [1020000,1080000) ms; same real existing chunk across T02/T03.

roots.cause: Native conversation retains historical evidence IDs while Supervisor retrieval_calls is recreated for every kick and retrieval_hit accepts only current registered hits.
Realtime result exposes the target chunk as available but does not register it for retrieval/read/frame tools; no direct authorized known-video/time rehydration path is exposed.
Provider JSON schema has optional search/cursor fields without a root conditional requirement; Python validator requires query/top_k/channel_weights when cursor is absent.

No shared executable target or precedence is defined across explicit user time, current playback and historical references. Realtime ignores query and always uses playback; generated alignment claim is not numerically checked.
Frame tool exposes a range and count with uniform midpoints instead of explicit point timestamps; requested point and sampled point can differ.
Interval event descriptions, historical events and sampled still images are combined into claims about an exact instant or continuous motion; existing still-image limitation was not followed.
